references.text: Describes how the Lord's anger was kindled against Israel because of their sin, and how he handed them over into the enemy's hand - the same pattern as in Judges 3:8
Warns that the Lord's anger will flare up against Israel if they break the covenant, and that they will be handed over to the enemies
Moses' song describing how the Lord 'sold' his people to the enemies as punishment for their apostasy
Summarizes the pattern where the Lord's anger burned against Israel and he sold them into the hands of the enemy, so that they could not stand against them
Another example of the same pattern where the Lord sold Israel into the hand of a hostile king as punishment
Yet another case where the Lord's anger burned against Israel and he sold them into the enemies' hands
Samuel reminds the people how they forgot the Lord, and he sold them into the enemies' hands
The prophet Isaiah uses the image that Israel was 'sold' because of their sins
An earlier example of the Lord's anger being kindled against Israel
Explains how the Lord rejected Israel and handed them over into the hands of plunderers because of their sin
